name: Key Packaging Co
old_description: YOUR KEY PARTNER FOR CUSTOM INNOVATIVE THERMOFORMING SOLUTIONS
about:
Key Packaging Co operates from Sarasota, Florida, specializing in custom thin-gauge thermoformed plastic packaging. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides end-to-end thermoforming services, including design and prototyping, in-house mold and tool building, thermoforming production, supply chain management, and quality assurance. Its capabilities cover a range of industries requiring protective and shipping trays, as well as retail and medical packaging.

Key Packaging serves medical device, pharmaceutical, automotive, cosmetic, retail, electronics, and food packaging markets. Customers include manufacturers needing protective trays for automotive and industrial components, as well as medical and pharmaceutical packaging that meets stringent quality requirements.

The company emphasizes a Lean Six Sigma culture, staffing Black and Green Belt personnel, and maintains ISO 9001:2015 certification. A ship-to-stock program allows qualified customers to bypass incoming inspection, reflecting a focus on process consistency and reliability.

name: Key Woodworking, Inc.
old_description: Keywood has been serving the DMV area projects since 1992 with passion.
about:
Key Woodworking, Inc. operates from Springfield, Virginia, in the Washington, D.C. metro area. The company was founded in 1992 by a first-generation immigrant who began as a one-man woodworking shop. Through decades of sustained effort, the business has grown into a small but capable firm serving the commercial construction market.

The shop specializes in custom-fabricated premium architectural woodwork, providing engineering services to align fabrication with design intent and managing material procurement from global sources including Europe, Africa, and Asia. Its craftsmen combine extensive experience with modern equipment to execute projects that have reached single-contract values exceeding $2 million, often on compressed schedules.

Key Woodworking focuses on upscale high-rise multi-residential buildings and Class A office towers, along with restaurants and public institutions throughout the DMV region. Past work includes amenity spaces, lobbies, and lounges for prominent developments in the Washington, D.C. area.

The company emphasizes a value set described as honest, hard-working, and innovative, backed by operational practices such as finely tuned scheduling, open communication, and a policy of taking full ownership of each project. These principles, the firm says, differentiate it from competitors and have sustained client relationships for over 30 years.

name: Keyser Manufacturing
old_description: OMI specializes in quality aftermarket ATV parts and accessories. ATVs are designed to be tough, but even the best made ride occasionally needs routine maintenance, an upgrade or a replacement part. OMI offers a great selection of products created to keep up with those hard driving off-road track or trail adventures. For aftermarket ATV parts and accessories shop … OMI ATV Products!
about:
Keyser Manufacturing operates from Coopersville, Michigan, where it produces race car components and provides contract fabrication services for a range of industries. The company describes itself as one of the largest manufacturers of race car parts in the United States, while also building custom parts for clients in automotive, tool and die, chemical, transportation, and other sectors.

Its in-house capabilities span CNC machining (lathes and mills), laser cutting with a Mitsubishi 2D LP Plus II 3,500-watt CO2 laser, waterjet cutting up to six inches thick, turret punching on a Strippit 1000/20 press, rolling and forming, and welding (MIG, TIG, and robotic cells). The shop also runs powder coating, anodizing, 3D printing for rapid prototypes, and a dedicated shock absorber development program. The company notes it can handle volumes from a single prototype to production runs of thousands, and its online catalog lists over 12,000 stocked products.

Customers come from automotive, tool and die, chemical processing, transportation, craft production, industrial equipment, shipping, government, and the racing and powersports markets. The firm's OMI ATV Products line targets off-road enthusiasts with shocks, cooling components, body parts, and suspension pieces.

Keyser Manufacturing emphasizes its willingness to quote jobs that other shops decline, along with quick turnaround times and in-house engineering support. Its waterjet process avoids heat-affected zones, and robotic welding cells improve consistency on larger orders.

name: Keystone Electrical Manufacturing Company
old_description: Since 1964, the Keystone team has fine-tuned its expertise in the design and production of power protection and control equipment. As part of Keystone’s services, we’ll manage your control system manufacturing process and ensure all design requirements are met – precisely and cost-effectively.
about:
Keystone Electrical Manufacturing Company has operated from Des Moines, Iowa since 1964. The company designs and builds power protection and control equipment for the electrical generation, transmission, and distribution sectors.

Its vertically integrated facility handles sheet metal fabrication, assembly, wiring, and testing in-house. The product line includes protection and control panels (line, distribution, transformer, bus differential, annunciator, feeder, metering, communication, SCADA/RTU), substation control centers ranging from 20-by-14-foot to 60-by-30-foot buildings, power distribution centers from 5 kV to 35 kV, medium voltage switchgear up to 38 kV, and low voltage control panels for OEMs. Engineering support services cover detailed bills of material, point-to-point wiring diagrams, AC/DC schematics, and as-built documentation.

Customers include electric utilities, utility-scale wind turbine and transformer manufacturers, voltage regulation system builders, industrial machinery OEMs, and renewable energy integrators. Keystone also works with overseas OEMs serving the U.S. market to meet NEC and UL 508A requirements.

The company cites its single-point project management, documented quality assurance program with in-process and final testing using a Doble F6150e test set, Peschel 100 kV Hi-Pot, and custom breaker simulator, and the option for customer facility inspections as key differentiators.

name: Ki USA Corporation
old_description: Our goal is to be a world class organization; through teamwork and communication, success is our future.  We specialize in manufacturing custom automotive parts and components for notable customers like Honda, Mazda, and Ford.  Our advanced metal stamping, electro-coat painting, and welding processes enable us to create the perfect solution for your company's needs.
about:
Ki USA Corporation has operated from Berea, Kentucky since 1989 as a subsidiary of American Industrial Acquisition Corporation. The company began as a manufacturer of automotive engine, body, and suspension components.

The firm specializes in precision metal stamping, robotic welding, and electro-coat finishing, delivering products such as engine mounts, brake boosters, and oil pans. Its 250,000-square-foot Kentucky facility on 54 acres employs about 160 associates, while a subsidiary in Irapuato, Mexico adds 45 employees and 3,288 square meters of production space. The vertically integrated platform combines stamping, welding, and e-coat under one roof, supported by programmable robotic welding systems and automated material handling.

Ki USA primarily serves the automotive industry, supplying Honda, Mazda, and Ford for internal combustion, hybrid, and electric vehicle platforms. It is expanding into power generation and home appliance sectors, leveraging its high-volume automotive and industrial production capabilities.

The company emphasizes trust, transparency, and continuous improvement, with an in-house e-coat line that ensures faster turnaround and strict quality control. Community involvement includes support for Relay For Life and Soles4Souls.

name: Kibberia Fresh Foods
old_description: Commercial kitchen offering over 350 products from around the world!
about:
Kibberia Foods operates commercial kitchens in Danbury, Connecticut and Lafayette, Louisiana. The company was founded by Carole Iskandar and her husband Sam, who began as restaurant owners in Danbury over a decade ago serving authentic Mediterranean cuisine. The business is family owned and operated. In 2021, they expanded to Lafayette to serve southeastern retailers.

The company produces more than 350 recipes, including an established line of 250-plus SKUs of all-natural, restaurant-quality prepared foods. Its capabilities include recipe research and development, rapid scale-up from concept to mass production within a week, and large-scale production with same-day ingredient processing. Facilities are SQF and HACCP certified, USDA inspected, and FSMA-ready.

Kibberia Foods supplies large retailers and supermarkets, offering products in individual, family-size, and food-service packaging. The company collaborates with retail partners to develop private-label lines and adjusts formulations for target price points, seasonal demand, and demographic preferences.

Founder Carole Iskandar’s Mediterranean heritage and commitment to food safety drive the mission to deliver fresh, healthy, nutritious food at cost-effective prices. The company emphasizes a boutique approach to recipe creation, donates surplus food to local charities, and maintains annual performance audits to ensure quality.

name: Kindel Furniture Company
old_description: Kindel Grand Rapids creates made-to-order furniture that bears your signature style.
about:
Kindel Grand Rapids, based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, traces its roots to 1886 when Albert F. Karges began making furniture in Evansville, Indiana. The modern entity formed when Kindel Furniture (founded 1901 by Charles J. Kindel) acquired Karges and Councill Furniture (founded 1973 by Fred and Hope Councill). The Fisher family has owned the business since 1964, maintaining a family-owned, 100% American-made operation.

The company produces made-to-order, handcrafted luxury furniture from its Grand Rapids facility. Offerings span dining, occasional, bedroom, and workspace collections, each built to customer specifications. The operation emphasizes domestic production, using traditional woodworking methods rather than offshore manufacturing.

Customers include residential clients seeking signature pieces and commercial offices requiring custom desks, tables, and credenzas. The Councill line has served workplace needs since 1973, while the Kindel and Karges brands address high-end home furnishings.

Kindel Grand Rapids differentiates itself through a commitment to domestic craftsmanship, preserving over 300 years of collective experience across its three heritage brands. The company states that every piece is made to precise customer specifications in its Michigan workshop, rejecting lower-cost offshore alternatives.

name: King's Wood Creation
old_description: We take your vision and put it to paper to bring you a rendering of your future kitchen. We then apply our years of knowledge to make it the best kitchen for you. From there, it's a breeze to your new space.
about:
King's Wood Creation operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it began over two decades ago as a one-man shop. The company has grown into a full-scale woodworking facility producing custom cabinets, doors, mantels, beams, furniture, and architectural millwork.

The shop runs CNC machinery alongside traditional woodworking equipment to fabricate kitchen and bath cabinetry, fireplace mantels, ceiling box beams, hand railings, and custom furniture. Services include design rendering, finishing, and carving, with the ability to source specialty timber on demand. The facility serves both one-off custom pieces and repeat production runs for builders.

Clients range from residential homeowners to building professionals such as contractors, architects, and interior designers. The company has supplied millwork for new construction, remodels, and custom home projects throughout the Phoenix area.

King's Wood Creation emphasizes material selection and in-house CNC capacity as differentiators, stating that it selects only the finest timber and can procure specialty woods as needed. The firm holds an Arizona Registrar of Contractors license (ROC #340054) and markets its products as proudly designed and produced in the USA.

name: Kingsford Manufacturing Company
old_description: Our charcoal has been proudly made in the USA since 1920. Available in a variety of flavors to give you a delicious, smoky taste for any occasion.
about:
Kingsford Manufacturing Company operates from Parsons, West Virginia, where it has produced charcoal products since its founding in 1920. The business began as a domestic charcoal operation and has remained a U.S.-based manufacturer for over a century, though the original founders are not identified in public records.

The company manufactures a range of charcoal briquets — including Original, Professional, Mesquite, Match Light instant-light, and Easy Light Bag single-use formats — as well as wood pellets for pellet grills. Production centers on carbonizing wood into uniform briquets, infusing flavor variants, and packaging for retail distribution. No facility dimensions, employee counts, or annual output figures are disclosed.

Kingsford serves the consumer grilling market, targeting backyard cooks, tailgaters, and outdoor cooking enthusiasts. Its products are sold through retail channels for use in charcoal and pellet grills, with recipe content aimed at seafood, steak, burger, and chicken preparation. The brand positions itself as a staple for game-day gatherings and seasonal cookouts.

The company emphasizes its American manufacturing heritage — “proudly made in the USA since 1920” — and a flavor portfolio designed to deliver premium smoke profiles at accessible price points, particularly for pellet grill owners seeking “premium flavor without the premium price.”
